commands.name: assemble_public_targets
commands.note: Assemble only existing hash-pinned public target parts; no nonce, private root or scalar labels are generated/read.

commands.name: public_equations_and_causal_trace
commands.note: Expected full panel has49152target-armcases; preserve any real nonzero result, missing coverage, wrong equation or partial record. SourceA verifier is standard-library independent EC arithmetic; no hidden labels.

commands.name: frozen_complete_panel_analysis
commands.note: Use exact same settings/targets paths as verifier. Strict frozen analysis refuses incomplete setups/targets; preserve failure and do not fabricate panels. Its primary_panel_eligible and aa_counter_mismatches remain observations.

commands.name: export_without_analysis
commands.note: Works with retained actual child rows and failed verifier summary; never pads unattempted slots. If frozen analysis succeeded, append --analysis-summary /workspace/classical-ecdlp-endpoint-reuse/postrun-RUN-ECDLP-b883bf-01/analysis/summary.json to this same command BEFORE its one write-once invocation. Producer metadata options may use actual known values only.

commands.name: official_check_export
commands.note: Retain stdout/stderr/exit code. Partial panels may have official coverage findings; do not change sample counts or statuses to silence them.

limitations: All wall_valid remain false; neither verification nor SDK IDs attest L2/dedicated physical host.
Public equations and observed causal state are checked; actual operation execution, omitted operations and native counter correctness are not independently replayed.
Public total order N is checked against Hasse/divisibility; verifier does not count every point.
Primary metric is complete setup plus online EC group_addition invocations; diagnostic scalar/doubling counters are not added into it.
One export row is one native child with64targetslots and one wait4rusage observation.
Analysis compares64curve clusters, preserving bothreplicates; incomplete full panels yield undefined comparison, never success-only gain.
No global novelty, cryptographic-scale runtime or exponent conclusion follows from this finite study.
